summary: Baker Hughes filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of Chart Industries via a merger. The filing confirms ongoing discussions with the European Commission regarding Phase I clearance, with potential commitments that are not expected to materially impact the deal's commercial rationale. The merger is on track to close in July 2026, subject to EC approval and customary conditions. This is a definitive M&A transaction where Baker Hughes is the acquirer, with regulatory timeline being the key gating item. The risk-arb spread will hinge on EC clearance and any required remedy details.
